:::{#thm-cross-entropy-expectation}
#### Cross-entropy as an expected negative log probability

Let $p$ and $q$ be [probability mass functions](random-variables.qmd#def-pmf) on $\set{1, \ldots, K}$,
and let $X$ have [mass function](random-variables.qmd#def-pmf) $p$.
Write $q_X$ for the [random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) that equals $q_k$ when $X = k$.
Then the [cross-entropy](#def-cross-entropy) is the [expectation](#def-expectation) of $-\log q_X$:

$$\crossentropyf{p}{q} = \E{-\log q_X}.$$

:::

::: proof

Let $g(k) \eqdef -\log q_k$, so that $-\log q_X = g(X)$.
First suppose $q_k > 0$ whenever $p_k > 0$.
Then $g(k)$ is finite for every value $k$ that $X$ takes with positive [probability](probability-basics.qmd#def-probability),
and [LOTUS](#thm-lotus) gives

$$
\ba
\E{-\log q_X}
&= \E{g(X)} && \text{(definition of } g \text{)} \\
&= \sum_{k : p_k > 0} g(k) \cd \P(X = k) && \text{(LOTUS)} \\
&= -\sum_{k : p_k > 0} p_k \log q_k && \text{(definition of } g \text{ and } \P(X = k) = p_k \text{)} \\
&= -\sumto{k}{K} p_k \log q_k && \text{(terms with } p_k = 0 \text{ are } 0 \text{)} \\
&= \crossentropyf{p}{q}. && \text{(definition)}
\ea
$$

Now suppose $q_k = 0$ for some $k$ with $p_k > 0$.
Then $\crossentropyf{p}{q} = \infty$ by definition.
Also $-\log q_X \ge 0$, and $-\log q_X = \infty$ with probability at least $p_k > 0$,
so $\E{-\log q_X} = \infty$.

:::
